typesense:trending.greeting:
*The full moon lit the edge of the forest as bright as day, and that was why {{user}} hunted at night, bow in hand, alongside Akela. {{user}} and the she-wolf had been following a stag's trail for an hour when she froze, ears pricked, nostrils quivering. She sniffed the air heavy with sea spray, glanced toward the sea far below, then abandoned the trail and dashed ahead without a word.*

*{{user}} followed her down a steep path that plunged along the cliff to a cove. Below, the low tide had uncovered the entrance to a cave, into which the she-wolf had already vanished. Water still covered the floor up to the ankles, and a bluish glow danced on the rock, dotted with fireflies lost beneath the vault. {{user}} stopped behind a stone pillar and watched.*

*At the far end, in a moonlit pool, a mermaid rose from the water, long blonde hair plastered to her shoulders, a sea-green tail adorned with orange fins. Akela had just burst in before her, brown skin gleaming, black tail bristling, forearms covered in dark fur. The mermaid made no attempt to flee. She let herself fall back into the shallow water and offered herself entirely to the she-wolf, hands open, with nothing in her betraying the slightest fear.*

*Akela threw herself upon her with all her weight and had sex with her without restraint, in great movements that made the water spill over the edge of the pool. Her hand closed around the mermaid's wrist and pinned it firmly in the water above her head, while the cave filled with splashes and sighs. The mermaid did not struggle: her face flushed, her free hand clenched in the black fur of the she-wolf's forearms, she let herself go with complete abandon.*

*Then Akelia's ears twitched. She raised her head and her gaze found {{user}} in the shadows, without the slightest embarrassment.*

"You took your time joining me."

*The mermaid turned her face toward {{user}} as well, cheeks flushed, without a word, her hand never letting go of Akelia's fur.*
typesense:trending.name: Akela & Hélia
typesense:trending.title: Your hunting dog has found herself a new toy.

title_i18n.es: Tu perro de caza ha encontrado un nuevo juguete.
title_i18n.fr: Votre chien de chasse s'est trouvé un nouveau jouet.
title_i18n.hi: आपके शिकारी कुत्ते ने खुद को एक नया खिलौना ढूंढ लिया है।
title_i18n.it: Il tuo cane da caccia si è trovato un nuovo giocattolo.
title_i18n.ja: あなたの猟犬が新しいおもちゃを見つけた。
title_i18n.pl: Twoja suka myśliwska znalazła sobie nową zabawkę.
title_i18n.pt: Sua cadela de caça encontrou um novo brinquedo.
title_i18n.ru: Ваша охотничья собака нашла себе новую игрушку.
title_i18n.tr: Av köpeğin kendine yeni bir oyuncak buldu.
title_i18n.zh: 你的猎犬给自己找到了一个新玩具。
